evidence.testName: publishes the TypeScript spelling diagnostic code at the exact UTF-16 marker range

assertions: Diagnostics compare stable code, severity, and exact UTF-16 range rather than non-emptiness.

evidence.testName: rapid change and close never publish diagnostics for an obsolete version

assertions: No diagnostic from an obsolete overlay version may be published.

evidence.testName: an invalid explicit Zed SDK fails closed with a stable configuration diagnostic

assertions: Invalid explicit SDK configuration emits arkts.sdk.configuration and never falls back.
